content_of_post_to_comment:
I have been trying to lose weight and improve my life again and again and again, multiple times now. And I am not talking about 6 months or 1 year. I am talking about years, like 10 years. I've been trying for 10 years, and I'm at the end of my straw.

Sure, life happened. The shittiest stuff that could happen to anyone happened to me, but I believe that is still no excuse. I am at a place where there is no rock bottom anymore, so I don't have any way but up.

Let me actually do this by the end of 2026.

I am not going to put very hard-and-fast goals, but just that:

- I need to be healthier.

- I need to be better and happier.

I want you guys to keep me accountable. I know that's not how the sub works, but I'm just going to pretend that you all are going to be watching me like hawks so that I actually end up doing the things that need to be done.

Also, while trying to figure this out, I started a brand of my own. I don't know if it will be successful or if I might go back to a day job. Either way, I've got 4 months, due to certain circumstances, when I have to be at home, so I'm going to maybe use that (4 months or maybe until the end of 2026) to figure out this brand, and hopefully I don't have to work for anyone anymore.

While I was working for the brand, I also got roped into helping out with another brand. That's basically two brands for me.

Here are my goals:

Brand work
Brand 1

I need to post at least once a day. I'm giving myself exactly 7 days to catch up on all the backlogs that I have so that, at one point, I can delegate stuff and focus only on the important things, putting in systems and stuff.

Brand 2

Again, that is not a very technical or strategic thing. I just have to bulk create once a week and post every single day.

Weight loss goals

I'm going to have 3 sessions:

- 15-minute workout session. It can be Pilates, callisthenics, strength training, or even yoga.

- 2 walking sessions: 1 in the morning and 1 before bed.

Mental health

I might not be on the spectrum, but I definitely do have neurodivergent traits, which are confirmed by my therapist as well. Rather than fighting it, I'm going to align my world and my processes to match that.

By the end of 2026, the most positive picture is that I have a brand that pays me enough so that I don't have to go for a job. I am healthy enough not to have to worry about anything, and I'm mentally more at peace.

TL;DR Daily Targets
WORK

- Brand 1: Post 1× daily + clear backlog during the first 7 days.

- Brand 2: Bulk-create once a week + post 1× daily.

BODY

- 15-min workout: Pilates / calisthenics / strength / yoga.

- Morning walk

- Night walk

MIND

Spend at least 10 minutes a day not spiraling or overthinking

Your ideas and feedbacks are always welcome.
comment: I actually like that your goals are process-based instead of "lose X pounds" or "make X money". After 10 years of restarting, the daily walks and 15-minute workouts seem like the kind of things that can rebuild trust with yourself. One thing I'd watch is taking on two brands while rebuilding your health—don't let ambition become another way to burn yourself out.
